articles.title: 'Love & War': Sanjay Leela Bhansali to reshoot war portions with Ranbir Kapoor, Alia Bhatt and Vicky Kaushal
articles.summary: Three weeks after 'Love & War' had officially wrapped, Sanjay Leela Bhansali decided he wasn't quite finished with it. Reports suggest the filmmak.
articles.body: Three weeks after 'Love & War' had officially wrapped, Sanjay Leela Bhansali decided he wasn't quite finished with it. Reports suggest the filmmaker, known for his exacting standards, wasn't fully satisfied with how the war sequences turned out, so he's brought Ranbir Kapoor, Alia Bhatt, and Vicky Kaushal back to set. Bhansali is said to be personally supervising the reshoots to get the battle portions right.A week-long shoot at Welcome MaidaanAccording to Mid-day, Bhansali will spend about a week filming the battle portions at Welcome Maidaan in Goregaon. He is extremely particular about how the war portions come together because they are integral to the film’s scale and emotional arc. Once he saw the material in the edit, he felt certain battle portions could be enhanced further. They are not changing what has already been shot, but are simply perfecting the sequence.Bhansali had already put in extensive shooting time at Royal Palms in Goregaon during 'Love & War's' final schedule. He's now personally supervising these additional scenes while working on the edit in parallel. There were also reports of the filmmaker planning to shoot one more song for the film, but that idea has reportedly been shelved for now.Ranbir Kapoor's upcoming projectOn the professional front, Ranbir Kapoor's next release is Nitesh Tiwari's 'Ramayana,' co-starring Sai Pallavi, Yash, and Sunny Deol. The film is being released as a two-part saga, with the first installment hitting theatres globally this Diwali 2026, and the second part following a year later on Diwali 2027.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Steven Spielberg surprised Ke Huy Quan with a $100,000 paycheck after ‘Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom’; actor reveals: 'Mom was holding an envelope with my name printed across it'
articles.summary: In his memoir 'Never Say Die', Ke Huy Quan recounts the touching moment when he received a $100,000 paycheck from Steven Spielberg after starring in 'Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom'. This unexpected gesture from the director and producer George Lucas highlights the generosity in Hollywood during the film's impressive box office success.
articles.body: Ke Huy Quan, who started his career in Hollywood at just 12 years old with Harrison Ford in ‘Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom,' recently opened up about starring in the film. In his recently released memoir, ‘Never Say Die,' the beloved actor opened up about a surprising incident from his time working on the film and how producer George Lucas and director Steven Spielberg gave him a surprise.Ke Huy Quan talks about Steven Spielberg’s surprise after ‘Indiana Jones'The actor recently published his memoir, ‘Never Say Die,' which encompasses his time in the industry, not getting any work, and getting a boost in his career with ‘Everything Everywhere All At Once.' In an excerpt from the book, as reported by Entertainment Weekly, Quan opened up about a pleasant surprise that the film's producer, George Lucas, and the award-winning director, Spielberg, left him with after the ‘Indiana Jones’ film was released.In an industry where most actors did not receive compensation from the film’s box office profits, he revealed that he received a cut after the adventure film made more than USD 300 million at the box office. He shared in the book, “One afternoon, I walked into the kitchen and found my parents standing together at the table. Mom was holding an envelope with my name printed across it. Dad had the papers that had been inside.” Quan had already been paid for his role in the film; however, the director and producer sent him an additional check.“They were both smiling, the kind of smile that comes from surprise and disbelief mixed together. They handed everything to me. It was a check from Lucasfilm. It was for almost $100,000, an amount that didn’t make any sense to me," he added. The actor also shared, “Back then, almost no actors got a piece of a movie’s profits. Even today, only the biggest stars do. That a kid like me, making his first film, would be included in something like that was unheard of. And Temple of Doom wasn’t some small movie no one was expected to see. It was the sequel to a massive hit, a movie everyone knew would make a lot of money. That made their gesture even more generous.”Calling it a life-changing moment for his family, Quan also commented on how much the extra money meant to his family.For the unversed, Ke Huy Quan played the young sidekick ‘Short Round,' a witty Chinese orphan in ‘Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom’ (1984), who accompanied Jones throughout all of his adventures. Quan scored the role after casting calls and auditions were held at his elementary school. Prior to this, he had never acted before.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: 'Angikaaram' OTT release date: When and where to stream Kotapadi J Rajesh and Sindhoori Vishwanath's sports drama
articles.summary: Tamil sports drama 'Angikaaram' is set to make its digital debut following its theatrical release earlier this year. The movie, which features Kotapad.
articles.body: Tamil sports drama 'Angikaaram' is set to make its digital debut following its theatrical release earlier this year. The movie, which features Kotapadi J Rajesh and Sindhoori Vishwanath was directed by Thenpathiyan. The film marks Kotapadi J Rajesh's debut as a feature filmmaker.When will 'Angikaaram' release on OTT?'Angikaaram' will begin streaming on Sun NXT on September 25. The streaming service shared the OTT update with a caption that gives a glimpse into the film's central conflict. "His only crime was daring to dream. Based on true events."What is 'Angikaaram' about?The movie centres on Aathiran played by Kotapadi J Rajesh. He is a talented runner who comes from a financially struggling family. His sporting abilities give him an opportunity to compete at the Commonwealth Games.However his path to the international sporting event is disrupted when his name is removed from the selection. Aathiran refuses to accept the decision quietly and takes the matter to court. His legal battle brings him into conflict with people who hold great influence within the sporting system. The story explores his attempt to challenge the circumstances that threaten his career.'Angikaaram' explores an athlete's struggleThe film uses Aathiran's journey to examine the difficulties faced by athletes without influential support. The conflict eventually takes the protagonist into the courtroom. His fight becomes more than an attempt to reclaim a place in a sporting event. Mansoor Ali Khan plays a minister connected to the conflict. Rama portrays Aathiran's mother, while Sindhoori Vishwanath is also part of the principal cast.What did ETimes say about 'Angikaaram'?ETimes gave 'Angikaaram' 2.5 stars out of 5. The review highlighted Kotapadi J Rajesh's performance and his physical preparation for the role."What keeps it watchable is Rajesh. For a producer turned actor, his debut is committed and physically convincing, with a real athlete's build and effort behind it. Ghibran's score works hard to pump in an urgency the writing mostly lacks. The subject, the way institutional politics smothers talent from the bottom rungs, deserves a film."The review also noted the contribution of composer Ghibran, particularly in creating intensity during the film's dramatic portions. With the OTT release, ' Angikaaram' is expected to gain wide reach among the audiences who missed it on the big screen.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: 'Hanuman Ansh' box office collection Day 46 [LIVE]: Vishal Chaturvedi and Shobhinaw Satyaa's spiritual biopic on Neem Kaorli Baba crosses Rs 273 crore India net on seventh Monday
articles.summary: 'Hanuman Ansh' continues its remarkable late-stage box office run, entering Day 46 with its India net collection now standing at Rs. 272.09 crore. Wha.
articles.body: 'Hanuman Ansh' continues its remarkable late-stage box office run, entering Day 46 with its India net collection now standing at Rs. 272.09 crore. What began as a slow, underwhelming opener has turned into one of the most unlikely long-haul successes of the year, powered by devotee support and sustained word-of-mouth, with the film's worldwide gross now inching towards the Rs. 350 crore mark. With its India net collection already at Rs. 272.09 crore, 'Hanuman Ansh' now has the Rs. 275 crore domestic mark firmly within reach, a milestone it could breach within the day given its current pace. On the global front, with the worldwide gross already past Rs. 347 crore, a push towards Rs. 350 crore looks imminent, keeping the film's extraordinary long-run success firmly intact as it continues to defy expectations set during its underwhelming opening weeks.'Hanuman Ansh's domestic box office runThe film’s theatrical journey has been defined by a significant turnaround. 'Hanuman Ansh' started with just Rs. 1.08 crore in its opening week, followed by Rs. 0.40 crore in Week 2. However, its fortunes changed dramatically from Week 3, when it collected Rs. 10.40 crore.The film then delivered Rs. 61 crore in Week 4, Rs. 90.25 crore in Week 5 and Rs. 80.25 crore in Week 6, taking its cumulative India net to Rs. 243.38 crore before the seventh-weekend earnings. It subsequently added Rs. 5 crore on Day 43, Rs. 9.75 crore on Day 44 and Rs. 13.75 crore on Day 45, taking the total to Rs. 271.88 crore.‘Hanuman Ansh’ overseas collection and worldwide totalThe film has also maintained a strong overseas contribution during its extended theatrical run. After Day 45, its overseas gross stood at Rs. 26 crore, while the India gross had reached Rs. 321.05 crore. This put the worldwide gross at Rs. 347.05 crore at the end of Day 45.'Hanuman Ansh' Day 46 collection live trackingAs per Sacnilk, 'Hanuman Ansh' is currently running across 5,870 shows on Day 46, having added a live collection of Rs. 1.74 crore so far in the day.This takes the film's overall India gross to Rs. 323.11 crore and its India net to Rs. 273.62 crore, with the final Day 46 figure expected once all shows for the day have concluded.Day wise collections for 'Hanuman Ansh'Week 1: Rs. 1.08 croreWeek 2: Rs. 0.40 croreWeek 3: Rs. 10.40 croreWeek 4: Rs. 61.00 croreWeek 5: Rs. 90.25 croreWeek 6: Rs. 80.25 croreDay 43: Rs. 5.00 croreDay 44: Rs. 9.75 croreDay 45: Rs. 13.75 croreDay 46 [LIVE]: Rs. 1.74 croreTOTAL: Rs. 273.62 croreMore about 'Hanuman Ansh'Directed and written by Vishal Chaturvedi, Hanuman Ansh is a spiritual drama inspired by the life, teachings and legacy of Neem Karoli Baba. The story follows a young boy who, after suffering a devastating loss, embarks on a transformative spiritual journey. The film explores themes of faith, compassion, humility and selfless service. Shobhinaw Satyaa leads the film, with Vihaan Shedge, Chandan K Anand, Purnima Tiwari, Anil Rastogi and Gulshan Pandey among the other members of the cast. The film has been certified U by the CBFC and has a reported runtime of around 2 hours and 30 minutes. It was released theatrically in Hindi on August 7, 2026.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and data in this article are compiled from diverse public and industry sources. All figures are approximate unless explicitly mentioned, offering a fair representation of the movie's box office performance. These totals may change as official studio data is updated or as additional international market reports are finalized. articles.title: Macklemore pro-Palestine row: Ed Sheeran’s cousin Jethros Sheeran calls him a ‘coward’: says, ‘You can’t silence me!’
articles.summary: For the past couple of days, Ed Sheeran has faced many challenges after the Macklemore row, with all of his supporting acts dropping out of the tour. .
articles.body: For the past couple of days, Ed Sheeran has faced many challenges after the Macklemore row, with all of his supporting acts dropping out of the tour. It seems Ed Sheeran and his cousin Jethro Sheeran have fallen out after the ‘Shape of You’ singer’s cousin called him a coward over the recent event. Read ahead to know more about what he had to say.Ed Sheeran’s cousin Jethro Sheeran calls him out after the Macklemore rowThe pop singer’s cousin, Jethro Sheeran, recently took to his Instagram account to share his thoughts on Ed, calling him a coward over everything that has happened recently. He posted about the singer and shared, “You can’t silence me! Ed Sheeran is a coward!! I’m embarrassed about this photo, but it’s 10 years old!" He shared a screenshot of a Facebook post with the same phrase written on it. He also shared an old photo of the two of them embracing, which he references in his comment.In another post shared on his page three days ago, Jethro stated he is “ashamed” of his cousin, adding, “Finally the world and all his fans see through him. He’s not a good person; I don’t like his music, so I can’t say he’s even a good artist. He’s honestly a selfish individual with malicious, cunning ways. ‘He kills you with kindness’ (His Words). I’m his first blood cousin, and he screwed me over and made fun of my mental health and mental health in general.”Calling him a “bad human," he mentioned, “He only cared about himself, and he puts out a fake narrative that’s calculated just to keep everyone happy so he can do big private gigs and keep brand deals, etc.”Ed Sheeran says that his family has abandoned himEd Sheeran recently broke down on stage while performing in Philadelphia over the weekend. Addressing the ongoing situation with Macklemore and his pro-Palestine comments, he read a statement about the saga. Videos of the artist were shared online, where he opened up about seeing the truth about many people.He added, in a video captured by a fan, the singer said, "In these situations you really find out who your friends are. It's been a weird week. It happened very quickly. At the same time, I had so many people telling me to cancel this tour, and so many people I've known for years and years and years, they're kind of backing away."He continued as the crowd of 50,000 attendees listened and cheered, adding, "In the back of my mind, I saw the ticket sales for this gig, and I didn't see cancellations; I saw people buying tickets for this gig. Everyone's telling me to cancel, and I'm feeling like all of my friends and family and people I know abandon me."Sheeran has expressed on multiple occasions that the decision to remove Macklemore from his ‘LOOP’ tour was not his. He shared that he attempted to mediate the situation with venues and organisers; however, the decision was never in his hands. Despite the explanation, the singer has faced significant backlash online from netizens, fans, and fellow celebrities in the industry.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more.
